title: Joe Oliver's white teeth and chewing tar
summary: A childhood impression of Oliver as a teenager with beautiful white teeth who always chewed a lump of tar.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
story.community_name: Remembering King Oliver: the man, the band, the decline

blocks.x: Well, let me tell you another memory I have of Joe Oliver that was funny. Although he was only 16 or something like that at the time, if my memory serves me right. He was, I see, much older to a kid who was four years old, five years old. And I was struck by what beautiful white teeth he had. And he always chewed a hunk of tar. You know that black stuff? Oh, yeah. They always chewed that.
I know those people did that.
